purpose: adjudicate whether arXiv 2607.09491v1 materially reopens a Binance structural-routing collector or instead strengthens the existing fail-closed organic-conversion family

paper.title: A Truckload of Satoshis: Detecting and Measuring One-Way Arbitrage in the Wild

rejections.reason: stablecoin smart-contract attack defense and anomaly detection; no permitted trading payoff or execution mechanism
Binance BTC perpetual archive audit explicitly reports negative net Sharpe under primary costs and no agent superiority
directional 15-minute mean reversion peaks near 1.3 bips gross per trade against a 5-bip round-trip benchmark cost
cross-chain transaction identification and matching for audit and tracing; no trading payoff
anti-money-laundering detection and report generation; no trading payoff
theoretical optimal stopping for win-martingales without executable market prices costs or a positive trading result
BFT block-time mixture diagnostics; no permitted prediction-market or exchange trading mechanism

paper_mechanism.path_identity: exactly two trades A1 to I to A2 with one non-anchor intermediary between two anchor assets; not a closed triangle and not an exactly-two-intermediary three-trade route
paper_mechanism.execution: two separate non-atomic orders because the studied exchanges did not support batch trading; the final leg is taker and the first leg may be maker or taker
paper_mechanism.inference: sequences are heuristically matched from anonymized public settled trades by quantity and latency without user identity or ground truth
paper_mechanism.direct_comparator: two-second VWAP immediately before the inferred first operation; not executable synchronized finite-size direct depth

paper_economics.trend: per-sequence price discrepancies and profitability declined while execution concentrated toward 0-10 millisecond bins
not_included_or_not_identifiable: fixed labor infrastructure and colocated execution costs

registry_adjudication.reason: the paper studies the same direct-versus-one-intermediary two-trade identity already covered by rank 44 and provides no current executable account-specific condition
registry_adjudication.strengthened_fact: large historical inferred settled-trade prevalence supports treating the route comparison as a real market mechanism rather than a purely algebraic possibility
registry_adjudication.retry_trigger: unchanged: an independently planned legitimate same-account organic conversion plus explicit read-only exact-symbol account commissions for the accepted shorter overlay; a material fee filter activity batching or execution change for the rejected exactly-two-intermediary extension

prohibited_shortcuts: calling the inferred aggregate estimate realized owned profit
using the paper fee tiers as current exact account commissions
treating a two-second VWAP comparator as executable synchronized depth
ignoring failed attempts fixed infrastructure or non-atomic unwind costs
reopening a three-trade route from evidence about a two-trade route
building another current collector without the literal registry retry trigger
